objective: Migrate the live defense minutes modal to the shared shadcn UI system while preserving official minutes, committee verdict, and ADM behavior.
changes: Replaced the custom portal and overlay with the shared Radix Dialog, including an accessible title, focus management, and controlled Escape dismissal.
Used shared Button, Select, RadioGroup, Input, Label, and Badge primitives with semantic theme tokens for tab and form controls.
Prevented mobile tab label overlap by retaining natural tab width inside the horizontally scrollable tablist.
Stabilized the empty entries fallback and removed unused imports/props from the component implementation.

verification.focused_tests: LiveDefenseMinutesModal.test.jsx: 2/2 passed; assertions cover no preselected verdict, radio selection, dialog naming, and Escape callbacks.
verification.eslint: Scoped ESLint passed with zero warnings and errors.
verification.prettier: Passed for the component, test, audit script, and inventory.
verification.build: Client production build passed with 4,853 modules transformed; existing Tailwind ambiguity, chunk-size, and plugin timing warnings remain.
verification.playwright: 12 synthetic screenshots captured for minutes, quick-entry, and consensus across light/dark at 1440x900 and 390x844. Select changes and radio choice were exercised; no horizontal overflow, Vite overlay, or application errors.

workflow_safety: The Playwright audit used synthetic, read-only API fixtures and did not invoke add-entry, verdict-submit, score-lock, or ADM-publish mutations.
known_blocker: ProjectDetailPage renders the modal conditionally but has no current call site that sets isLiveMinutesOpen to true; route reachability requires separate investigation.
